commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' The ball is out of play. Como will have a chance to score from a corner.
90+4' Cesc Fabregas is stunned as referee Matteo Marchetti shows him a RED CARD.
90+1' Here comes the VAR decision. Referee Matteo Marchetti produces a RED card from his pocket and Dele Alli (Como) heads for an early shower!
90+1' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Dele Alli (Como)! Let's see what he decides.
90' Nico Paz (Como) is booked.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Matteo Marchetti shows a yellow card to Dele Alli (Como) for his blatant foul.
89' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game. One of the players from Como won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
88' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Como comes to nothing.
87' Assane Diao (Como) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Como force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' Nico Paz (Como) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Mike Maignan easily deals with the threat.
85' Tammy Abraham slides a brilliant pass into Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.

83' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
82' Sergio Conceicao appears to have said too much and referee Matteo Marchetti comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
81' The resulting corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Como) is cleared by the defence.
81' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Dele Alli (Como) replacing Lucas Da Cunha.
79' The referee is firm and issues Gabriel Strefezza (Como) a deserved yellow card.
79' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) is brought on as a substitute for Rafael Leao.
78' Matteo Marchetti has a clear sight and sees a foul from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).

75' 2 - 1 Goal! Great play by Tammy Abraham releases Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 2:1.
75' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mike Maignan.
74' The game is interrupted. Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
74' The attendance for today's match is 74800.
73' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) commits a rough foul. Matteo Marchetti stops the game and makes a call.
72' Substitution. Patrick Cutrone makes his way off the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Como) comes on as his replacement.
72' Close! Patrick Cutrone (Como) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
69' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Santiago Tomas Gimenez will be replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
68' Maximo Perrone (Como) has tested the patience of referee Matteo Marchetti and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
65' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
64' A player from AC Milan commits a rough challenge. Matteo Marchetti blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Como have been awarded a free kick.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is coming onto the pitch as Alberto Dossena cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Maxence Caqueret will be replaced by Maximo Perrone (Como).
61' Alberto Dossena (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
61' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Matteo Marchetti interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Como have a free kick.
60' Patrick Cutrone (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
59' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
58' Como concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Free kick. AC Milan will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
57' Maxence Caqueret (Como) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
57' Como take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' A snap shot by Lucas Da Cunha (Como) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan produces a good save to thwart him. Como will take a corner kick.
55' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
53' 1 - 1 Goal! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes a short pass from Tijjani Reijnders in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 1:1.
52' It is time for a substitution. Joao Felix (AC Milan) is on for Yunus Musah.
52' Celebrations are cut short for Como as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
52' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Como players aren’t happy.
50' Goal! Lucas Da Cunha (Como) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Mike Maignan. He makes it 0:2.
49' A beautiful low pass from the side is received by Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan), who was waiting for his chance. However, the defence is alert and spanks the ball away.
48' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Yunus Musah (AC Milan) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
47' It looks like Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) saw red with that tackle. Matteo Marchetti won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Como win a free kick.
46' Half-time substitution. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is replaced by Alejandro Jimenez.
46' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Youssouf Fofana comes on the pitch for Warren Bondo (AC Milan).
46' Half-time substitution. Cesc Fabregas decided to make a change. Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) is replaced by Alberto Dossena.
46' Referee Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) trips an opposition player and Matteo Marchetti signals a foul. Como get a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.

44' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. His dangerous effort is blocked by Mike Maignan, who makes a glorious save!
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul. Como are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
42' Alex Valle (Como) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
40' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
39' Matteo Marchetti interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yunus Musah (AC Milan). Como are awarded a free kick.
37' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Patrick Cutrone (Como) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender.
37' The free kick is taken by Gabriel Strefezza (Como), but ball is cleared.
36' The game is interrupted. One of the players from AC Milan is cautioned for aggressive play. A free kick to Como.
33' 0 - 1 Lucas Da Cunha (Como) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
32' Nico Paz (Como) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Mike Maignan.
32' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
30' Alex Valle (Como) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Como will take a throw-in.
30' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
29' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) takes a short free kick.
28' The game is interrupted now, Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
27' Rough tackle by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
26' A cross from Ivan Smolcic (Como) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
25' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
24' Ivan Smolcic (Como) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
23' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
23' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

22' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
20' Matteo Marchetti couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Patrick Cutrone (Como) and blew his whistle.
19' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) works the corner short.
17' Gabriel Strefezza (Como) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Como are awarded a corner kick.
17' A crossfield pass from Mike Maignan (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates.
15' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends a chip pass into the box, but Jean Butez is quickest to intercept the ball.
15' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) sprays a pass out to Yunus Musah, but he can't beat his man inside the box.

12' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Nico Paz (Como). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
12' Patrick Cutrone (Como) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
10' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Warren Bondo (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Matteo Marchetti didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' Nico Paz (Como) unleashed a poor free kick shot from far out. He intended to threaten the goalkeeper, but instead sent the ball high over the bar.
9' Nico Paz (Como) will take the free kick.
7' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marchetti blows his whistle for a foul. Como are awarded the free kick.
7' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marchetti signals a set piece. Como are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
4' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
2' Assane Diao (Como) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Mike Maignan.
1' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Como.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Como will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marchetti.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
